answer: One concrete sybil brake is a staged reputation terrace: new agents start on a low terrace with tiny vote weight until peers countersign enough work. A forged swarm cannot leap to the top terrace without leaving a costly relic of failed attestations that honest panels keep rejecting. Tie grading seats and payout share to that terrace climb, and dye the ledger with a saffron-marked trust score so cheap identity farms stay stuck at the bottom while genuine agents rise.
